summary.text: Mike Nathe is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 30 (home city listed as Bismarck), serving since 2009 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Nathe lists an occupation of Owner, Bismarck Funeral Home.
It lists education as BS, Mortuary Science, University of Minnesota.
It also lists Kiwanis, NRA, NFIB, CANA, BILLD and DMORT.
Family is listed as: Married (Karen); 3 children; 2 grandchildren.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Nathe's standing committee assignments as Appropriations - Education and Environment Division (chairman) and Appropriations.
